def: to tower up (be conspicuous), i.e. (by implication) to be suitable or proper (third person singular present indicative, often used impersonally, it is fit or right)

occurrences.text: And Jesus answering said unto him, Suffer it to be so now: for thus it becometh us to fulfil all righteousness. Then he suffered him.
Judge in yourselves: is it comely that a woman pray unto God uncovered?
But fornication, and all uncleanness, or covetousness, let it not be once named among you, as becometh saints;
But (which becometh women professing godliness) with good works.
But speak thou the things which become sound doctrine:
For it became him, for whom are all things, and by whom are all things, in bringing many sons unto glory, to make the captain of their salvation perfect through sufferings.
For such an high priest became us, who is holy, harmless, undefiled, separate from sinners, and made higher than the heavens;

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
